edits.old: Each of the nine consumed operations is declared on its service base with one hop and a 2 s timeout; the element names are confirmed by the owners at review (GAP-2503).
edits.new: Each of the nine consumed operations is declared on its service base with one hop and a 2 s timeout; the element names are confirmed by the owners at review (GAP-2503). Each consumed operation is a one-hop REST contract of its owner. Until an owner publishes the operation name and payload, the consumed rows of section 12.2 carry the placeholder and the build runs against that owner's fake from Day 1. The payments read answers one row per payment_code ordered by paymentCode ascending, unpaged, with a configured row cap; what a call answers when the cap would be exceeded is recorded in the next version of the API Specification. A duplicate payment_code is routed to the REC-05 break list of RWB-P1-E1011-APP once the data-quality owner confirms it is a break. The two reads are published on /api/recovery/source-data/v1 with the businessDate query parameter and the elements PaymentsAnswer, PaymentFact, BatchStatusStamp, ProductStamp and InstallmentFacts; their resource names and status set are taken from the OpenAPI fragment of the service baseline at the wave 2 freeze, and the resource names are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0599).
